Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request successful
E_NOT_OK: Request failed

CRYPTO_E_KEY_NOT_AVAILABLE: Request failed, at least one

CRYPTO_E_KEY_READ_FAIL: Request failed, not allowed to

Copies a key with all its elements to another key in the same crypto driver. Note: If the actual
key element is directly mapped to flash memory, there could be a bigger delay when calling this
function (synchronous operation)
